text:
Maya: Morning team — quick async check-in.
Maya: What I did: scheduled the landing page hero copy, pushed draft for the benchmark post, synced with eng on metrics tracking.
Maya: Blockers: waiting on final numbers from ENG infra for latency chart. @Alex any update on the invocations-per-minute metric export?
Alex: Working on a small fix to the export script, should have data by EOD. Pinging @Sam for config review.
Sam: Ack, will review in 15. If it's a `cron` windowing bug we can bump to 1m sampling.
Jordan: Heads up — launch readiness doc updated. Added a fallback plan if the dedicated pool spikes. Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/launch-readiness
Emily: Content calendar update: moved benchmark post to Thu AM, hero copy goes live Wed 9:00 PDT. Need final screenshots from QA to lock visuals.
Maya: For screenshots, @deploy-bot can you confirm the staging branch has the latest images and the feature flag is on?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staging `release/feature-hero-img` deployed at 1798881300. All pods green. :white_check_mark: Feature flag `hero_v2` = true.
Alex: Got the metrics dump, uploaded CSV to the shared drive. Quick note — model p99 latency peaked ~180ms during the load test at ~11:12.
Maya: Thanks — I'll update the benchmark draft to reflect p50/p95/p99. Also need a tiny code review on the embed snippet in the post. @Sam can you take a look?
Sam: On it, will leave comments in PR #452 tonight. If it's small I can merge before midnight.
Jordan: Also, marketing-squad has a 30m pre-launch sync at 3pm PT today — we usually run through A/B variants and rollout thresholds.
Emily: No blockers from biz ops. Once screenshots + metrics are final I’ll assemble the asset pack and hand off to design for final QA. :thumbsup:
Maya: One more ask — if anyone sees regressions in console logs during the next staging run, paste small snippets here. Prefer short excerpts like: `ERROR inference: kv cache miss` or `WARN batching: dropped 2 requests`.
Alex: Will do. Shared a quick grep command in case it's useful: `kubectl logs -l app=inference | grep -E "ERROR|WARN" | tail -n 200`.
Maya: Perfect. If no other blockers I’ll close the loop by EOD and post final copy in this thread. :rocket:
